title: Does ROS 2 traffic leave the machine? ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY vs ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE, measured on eth0
excerpt: On one machine only DDS discovery (3-4 KB per 10 s) reached eth0; the message data never did. ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1 or ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST cut it to 0 with Fast DDS and Cyclone on Humble and Jazzy, plus why ros2 topic list comes back empty.
